core_group_boundary.explanation: getCore coverage lists selected core facts only; it omits separate day-growth and optional stages. A coverage group is not the entire candidate bill.
core_group_boundary.Q_rule: Its paid CORE group remains charged despite candle refusal. Safe data has no vendor business code/headers, so no precise backoff-cause inference.

run_candidate_counters.meaning: Reservation counters keyed by candidate_id, across request stages; they are a different projection of the same receipts and must not be added.
run_candidate_counters.qualification: candidate_id is not in saved durable receipt rows. Overview wrapper requests can have null candidate_id while getCore reuses their price. This explains why neither 3/7/3 nor the 3-item coverage groups are a complete exact per-block bill. Do not force residual IDs into BEAM/Q using time ordering.

cache.reason: These flags/counts are absent from the safe projection; no fake cache-hit ratio or zero-cost source coverage.
cache.known: Exact shared evidence_ref proves same originating receipt; this is reuse of paid data, not by itself proof of a broker cache hit. Original run receipts are charged once. A repeated fact reference is not a new receipt.
cache.current_rule: Broker checks in-flight/negative/positive cache before reserving new request. Reuse preserves originating response and native fact clock; stale funding is not made fresh.

economical_coverage.known: This saved original run charged 2 shared discovery +14 BingX CORE +2 BingX delivery +1 Telegram. MAGMA used exactly two optional attempts, trades1+funding1. Readiness/deadline and qualification control optional work. Failures consume slots; unqualified OI costs no attempted HTTP.
economical_coverage.limits: One run/three candidate counters is not a fixed candidate rate or all-universe coverage. Cost depends on qualified candidates, cache/clock validity, retries/refusals, delivery, outcome work and provider pacing.

budget_preservation.rule: Counters are at saved observation, not fresh available capacity or new admission. Preserve all spent, outstanding, UNKNOWN, CLOSED grants, holds and protected future delivery/outcomes/manual/discovery/candidate reserves. Do not subtract holds twice or refund unused/unusable data. Run unknown0 does not reset historical unknowns. No budget changes.

why: Single bounded run contains no complete day/month denominator, future candidate distribution or full-universe sample.
No full cache-use/cadence/window-lifetime trace, all-day pacing/backoff or retry/refusal history.
Remaining daily/monthly counter arithmetic ignores protected future work and live obligations; it is not spend permission.
Saved candidate quota maximum3/issued3 is one period's state, not a permanent per-cycle/day promise.
